title: The Basement Cat
lines: Ray was in bed when he heard a sound.
It came from down in the basement.
For a moment he sat still in the dark.
Then he heard a small movement down there.
Ray got up and went to get Mom.
"Can we look?" he said. Mom said, "I will go first."
Mom came down the steps with a lamp.
Ray held the rail and stayed behind her.
At first they saw just cans and rags.
He looked under the steps, but all was still.
Then a box in the back tipped over.
Mom held up the lamp to look.
A small gray cat sat in the box.
It had three kittens tucked next to it.
Ray's fear turned into excitement.
"Can they stay?" he said. "If you feed them."
That was the agreement Ray and Mom made.
He ran up and got them food in a bowl.
Now the cat naps in a warm box by the door.
The three kittens play on the rug all day.

questions.ask: What did Ray hear at the start?
questions.listenFor: A sound from the basement, then a small movement. Lines one to four.
A small gray cat with three kittens tucked next to it. Line thirteen and line fourteen.

questions.ask: What was the agreement Ray and Mom made?
questions.listenFor: The cats can stay if Ray feeds them. Two people agree — that is what an agreement is.
